hardware.name: gtx1660_6gb
hardware.notes: Keep one model loaded. OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1. Close Chrome/Studio if VRAM >90%. gameplay/client/repair/refactorer use num_ctx=4096. Prefer installed tags from `ollama list`.

repair._comment: A33/A34: repair 7B num_ctx 4096 (slim REPAIR MODE ~1200 + one-error snippet)

compact._comment: A15: state_hub summaries use local 7B, not DeepSeek/14B

ollama._comment: Default num_ctx=2048; gameplay/client agents override to 4096. Prompt budget 14B<=3000 / 7B<=1000. On HTTP 404, rematch via /api/tags.

spacebunny._comment: Optional cloud only when FORGE_BACKEND=spacebunny and Ollama is down. Not used for local Live Ops.

openrouter._comment: Optional cloud only when FORGE_BACKEND=openrouter and Ollama is down. Override with OPENROUTER_MODEL. Never send these tags to local Ollama.
